diagnosis: The DownloadPrescription handler retrieves confidential medical prescription records by extracting the prescriptionID URL parameter and querying the repository directly, without checking whether the record belongs to the authenticated patient in the request context. An authenticated patient can access other patients' medication histories, dosages, and prescribing doctors.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/prescriptions/rx_90214/download HTTP/1.1
Host: telehealth.healthcare-portal.com
Authorization: Bearer patient_jwt_token_8812
Accept: application/json
